headline: Mod installs and Windows fixes land as Going Commando matching advances
summary: OpenRAC development gains indexed mod installs, corrected diagonal movement, Windows audio and visual fixes, plus object inspection and freecam tools; experimental light authoring remains disabled by default. Stable receives a direct PAL level 11 lighting-bake fix rather than a release PR (OpenRAC#189), while the Going Commando native port remains an unplayable draft. Going Commando's final USA v1.01 snapshot reaches about 84.74% matched code by size, while Ratchet & Clank reorganises its fully matched code and Deadlocked adds PAL reconstructions. Archipelago v2.1.0 isolates saves by room, Difficulty v1.2.4 fixes Blarg Station's landing, and Item Randomizer v1.0.4 also releases against Mod SDK 1.11.0. Players can help test randomizer logic through openrac-mods#25; co-op remains draft work.
